beschreibung: Jahrmarkt-Symbole, Teil 3: 17 Kunststücke und 12 Übungen als Medaillon-Bilder (Narrenhof).
stil: Painterly storybook oil illustration of a single object as a round medieval fairground medallion icon: the object centred on a deep warm brown wooden background with a thin gold ring, rich colours, warm candlelight, soft shadows, detailed but clearly readable at small size, whimsical royal fool's court and travelling fair mood. Square composition, object fills about 70% of the image with margin around. No text, no letters, no numbers, no characters, no faces, no card frame.
ohne: text, letters, numbers, watermark, people, animals, faces, hands, modern objects, logos, border, frame, photo
